fmt.o: 21-day estimate vs the average share, its percentile, low, high; then the same for 63 days (basis points, percent)
fmt.c: contributions of each input to the 21-day estimate (basis points, order of feats)
fmt.sm: average return by calendar month (tenths of a percent)
fmt.sx: average return against the Nifty 50 (tenths of a percent)
fmt.sb: share of years it beat the Nifty 50 (percent)
fmt.st: t of the average against the Nifty across years (x10); months with under 5 years are null
fmt.ss: seasonality input now: same 21 / 63 days in past years vs the average share (basis points), years used
fmt.x: percentile of each input today among eligible shares (0-100, order of feats; 50 = missing)
fmt.typ: its own 21-day and 63-day moves over the last 3 years: 10th and 90th percentile (basis points)

label.seas: Seasonality: same weeks in past years
